proposal.summary: Command Injection in Liman Central Management System Liman MYS (HTTP/Controllers, CronMail, Jobs modules) affecting versions from 1.7.0 before 1.8.3-462.
proposal.affected_product: Liman Central Management System Liman MYS: from 1.7.0 before 1.8.3-462
proposal.cwe_quote: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection') vulnerability
proposal.recommended_next_step: Request or review a technical advisory or patch details showing the vulnerable code paths and whether user-controllable input reaches command execution; obtain exploitability details and reproducer to confirm impact and publish fixes.

evidence_quotes.quote: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection') vulnerability
